summary: Youxin Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with Aegis Capital Corp. on June 25, 2026. The company may sell up to $6,355,771 of its Class A ordinary shares under its existing F-3 shelf registration (File No. 333-295763). Sales will be at prevailing market prices on Nasdaq, with a 3.0% commission to Aegis. This is an ordinary equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or other transformative elements.
